allow: Running the repository's own build, lint, test, format and package-manager commands (pnpm, nx, go, terraform fmt/validate/test, helm template, kubeconform, python3 scripts under tools/) inside the sandbox, including with inline environment variable prefixes such as NX_DAEMON=false or PATH=... and with output redirected to a log file under /tmp or the session scratchpad.

Installing the repository's declared dependencies (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, go mod download) and downloading release artifacts from github.com, nodejs.org, registry.npmjs.org, proxy.golang.org or releases.hashicorp.com solely to verify them against checksums or pinned values already recorded in the repository.
Writing and running throwaway helper scripts or config files under /tmp or the session scratchpad that only wrap the repository's own commands, as long as nothing from them is committed.
Non-force pushes of commits to a feature branch the task names, and reading pull requests, check runs and job logs through the GitHub tools.
